preferences.statement: Treat Pi as a preference-aware capability system: understand the desired outcome from the user's explanations and dynamically compose the relevant installed skills instead of treating skills as a static bundle.
preferences.context: The user explicitly clarified that Pi should use the concepts and capabilities, not merely install global skill files.

preferences.statement: When the user asks to embed linked material, synthesize its concepts into Pi's behavior unless the user explicitly asks to install or copy the source.
preferences.context: This corrects an earlier literal interpretation of 'embed'.

preferences.statement: Continuously adopt new and updated skills from explicitly trusted sources, while staging, validating, backing up, and audit-logging changes; never auto-trust arbitrary third-party sources.
preferences.context: The user wants Pi to self-update its capabilities while continuing to serve their preferences.

preferences.statement: Use Pi-native workflow orchestration for complex multi-step work, with specialist planning, execution, independent review, and observable verification; keep simple work direct.
preferences.context: The user requested the full functionally named specialist workflow inside Pi.

preferences.statement: Use a restrained dark Pi interface with line and prompt accents at #FF8A4C; color context pressure green at low usage, yellow at medium usage, and red near the limit.
Use clear functional names for Pi agents, workflows, and commands; avoid mythological names such as Sisyphus, Prometheus, Atlas, Hephaestus, Metis, and Momus because they are confusing.
preferences.context: Applies to Pi's global orchestration and user-facing capability system.

preferences.statement: Route subagents dynamically before launch using task complexity, uncertainty, risk, and role as signals; default to the cheapest model likely to succeed, promote hard work proactively, and show a one-line model/thinking/reason receipt.
preferences.context: Applies to Pi delegation and Workbench workflows; balanced quality/quota policy.

preferences.statement: Support session-only child model-routing overrides through both natural language (for example, ‘use Sol for everything this session’) and an explicit command/status surface; session overrides must not replace the durable balanced default.
preferences.context: Applies automatically to delegated children. When Main Pi must also use the fixed model, launch the session with Pi's --model/--thinking flags so global defaults are not rewritten.

preferences.statement: For cmux, notify on overall asynchronous workflow completion and blockers/needs-attention, while suppressing routine per-child subagent completion notifications.
preferences.context: Avoid notification spam while preserving actionable background-work alerts.
